verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents in-platform task assignment with deadlines (owners and due dates) and continuous monitoring with alerts and evidence collection. Its AI evidence check validates uploaded evidence for timeliness, which loosely implies some staleness awareness. However, nothing shows a dedicated workflow for manual artifacts with recurring renewal reminders or per-artifact expiry tracking. Missing for 10: explicit owner/due-date assignment on each manual evidence artifact, renewal reminders, expiry tracking/recurrence for manual uploads, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
